name: Ikaris

abilityDetails.Power Detonation: Doğal olarak süresi dolduğunda enerji hasarı verir; şampiyon özel saldırı kullanırsa bu etki kaldırılır.
abilityDetails.Energize: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Protection: Tüm kaynaklardan alınan hasarı belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Energy Vulnerability: Enerji Direncini azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen enerji hasarını artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): E2 kullanmasına izin verme — engellenemez olabilir. Energize bonuslarını nötralize/nötrleştirerek kontrol et. Diğer sınıflar sık enerji hasarı aldığı için sadece Mystic kullan.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Cosmic sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Energy Backblast
Every time an Opponent tries to apply an effect on Ikaris that he is immune to, inflict an Energy Vulnerability Passive reducing Energy Resistance by [195.65 - 963.21] for 10 second(s). Max 10 stacks
immunityDetails:
• Yakma Bağışıklığı 🔥
• Şok Bağışıklığı ⚡️
• %20 Zehir direnci 🧪

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: All basic attacks are Energy Damage.
Immune to Incinerate, Shock and reduces the damage of Poison by 20%.

abilitySections.title: When Struck by a Medium Attack
content: Inflict a Power Detonation Debuff lasting 15 seconds. If Power Detonation expires naturally the Opponent receives a burst of 200% Energy Damage. If the Opponent launches a Special Attack this Debuff is removed with no penalty. Cooldown 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Energize (Max: 10)
content: Gain +1 Energize whenever either champion strikes or hits into block with a Light Attack.

Each Energize Buff has 0% potency and lasts indefinitely until consumed and while 1 or more Energize Buffs are active gain +70% Combat Power Rate. The effect of Energize is reduced by 50% when used as a Defender. This Combat Power Rate cannot be increased or decreased by outside sources.
While +7 Energize Buffs are active: Whenever Ikaris's Power is reduced for any reason, inflict the Opponent with a burst of [508.08] Energy Damage per Energize Buff. No effect against Mystics.
All Special Attacks consume 10 Energize Buffs on hit.
Landing a Heavy Attack inflicts the Opponent with Incinerate Debuffs equal to 50% of the Energize Buffs and removes 1 Energize Buff.

abilitySections.title: Incinerate - Max 225
content: Incinerate will deal +[381.06] as Energy Damage over 22 seconds. Incinerate Debuffs also remove Perfect Block Chance and decrease Block Proficiency by 50% while active.
Landing a Heavy Attack pauses all Incinerate Debuffs for 8 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Inflicts 3 Incinerate Debuffs on each hit. The last hit will remove all Incinerates and apply them all back with full durations.
If Ikaris has 10 Energize Buffs, gain a Protection Buff for 30 seconds preventing Ikaris from taking more than 5% of max health from a single hit. Excluded from damage on Special 3.
If Ikaris has less than 10 Energize Buffs, gain an Armor Up Buff increasing Armor Rating by +[964.29] for 30 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Double all Incinerate Debuffs. If Ikaris has no Incinerate Debuffs on the opponent, apply 10.
If Ikaris has 10 Energize Buffs, gain an Unblockable Buff for 8 seconds on special activation.
If Ikaris has less than 10 Energize Buffs, gain +[3,375] Physical Resistance Buff for 30 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: True Damage Attack that applies a bonus +[1,270.2] Attack Rating per unique buff currently on Ikaris.
Each Incinerate Debuff on the Opponent grants a +[508.08] Attack Rating for this attack. Consume all but 10 Incinerates.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Energy Backblast
content: Every time an Opponent tries to apply an effect on Ikaris that he is immune to, inflict an Energy Vulnerability Passive reducing Energy Resistance by [195.65 - 963.21] for 10 second(s). Max 10 stacks
